qrcodes.onSiteDesc: Place QR codes on tables, counters or exit points of your business. Encourage customers to scan the code after service.
qrcodes.inMaterialsDesc: Add QR codes to business cards, receipts, product packaging, or any material customers take with them.
qrcodes.onlineDesc: Share the QR code image on your social media, website, emails or newsletters for customers who visited your business.
qrcodes.tipDesc: Create specific QR codes for different spots in your business or campaigns. This helps compare opens and clicks through to Google at each touchpoint.

reply.title: Reply suggestions
reply.copiedToast: Reply copied. Paste it wherever you're replying.
reply.copyErrorToast: Couldn't copy automatically. Select the text and copy it manually.
reply.footerPublic: Binno doesn't publish replies on your behalf: the public reply has to go out from your Google business profile. Copy it, paste it there, and adjust what only you know.
reply.footerPrivate: This message goes straight to whoever wrote to you. Never offer anything in exchange for removing or changing a public review — that's against Google's rules and the law.

whatsappPilot.interestsTitle: What would you like to receive?
whatsappPilot.interestsBody: Select only the alerts that are useful to your routine.
whatsappPilot.weeklyBody: Rating, volume, replies, topics, and the week's priority.
whatsappPilot.repliesBody: An alert when an observed review does not show a reply yet.
whatsappPilot.reputationBody: Relevant drops, low ratings outside the pattern, and repeated causes when evidence is sufficient.
whatsappPilot.profileBody: Reminders about hours, photos, and profile information after the official connection is active.
whatsappPilot.notificationRecipientHint: Enter the business owner's number. Future summaries and alerts will go there.
whatsappPilot.onboardingPhoneHint: Filled in during onboarding. Edit it only if notifications should go to another owner.
whatsappPilot.testRecipientHint: Enter your own number or a team member's. This test is never sent to a customer.
whatsappPilot.weeklyChangeEmpty: No change has been confirmed this week.
whatsappPilot.preferencesSaved: Preferences saved. Binno will use these choices for the delivery queue.
whatsappPilot.backendUnavailable: The delivery channel is not available yet. Try again after the server is configured.
whatsappPilot.deliveryBody: Binno records the send and follows the status reported by the connected channel.
whatsappPilot.deliveryReadyBody: Messages are placed in the Binno queue. The status changes when the channel confirms the send.
whatsappPilot.testQueued: Message queued for {{recipient}}. The panel will show the state when the channel responds.

delivery.accepted: The channel accepted the message for {{recipient}}.
delivery.failed: The latest message could not be delivered.
delivery.skipped: The latest message was not sent.

localWhatsApp.proxyUnavailable: The local OpenWA proxy is unavailable. Start the preview with BINNO_ENABLE_OPENWA_PROXY=true and configure the local key.
localWhatsApp.apiKeyRequired: The local OpenWA key is not configured on this computer. Sending remains blocked.
